PersistentLayer
|
|-- DiagramStore                                  repository facade
|   |-- Project
|   |   |-- id / name
|   |   `-- sources[]: DiagramSourceBinding
|   |       `-- source identity / corpus / domain profile
|   |
|   |-- diagramPersistence: DiagramPersistence
|   |   |-- persist(value) -> immutable record references
|   |   |-- restore(value) -> portable diagram/history data
|   |   `-- DiagramRecordStore -> DiagramRevisionStore
|   |
|   |-- Diagram source ownership -> Canvas domain model / [B]
|   |   `-- Diagram.sourceContext: binding / mappings / captured evidence
|   |
|   `-- canvases: CanvasCatalogStore               owns composition and publication
|       |
|       |-- RepresentationCatalog
|       |   |-- projectId
|       |   |-- activeByKind                       selected representation per view
|       |   |
|       |   |-- representations[id]: Representation
|       |   |   |-- id / name / kind / status
|       |   |   |-- currentRevisionId ------------> revisions[id]
|       |   |   `-- revisionIds[]                  retained history
|       |   |
|       |   |-- revisions[id]: RepresentationRevision
|       |   |   |-- id / revision
|       |   |   |-- representationId -------------> representations[id]
|       |   |   |-- provenance?                    originating artifact
|       |   |   |
|       |   `-- content                            saved content variants
|       |       |-- kind: canvas-history
|       |       |   `-- history                    canvas checkpoint metadata
|       |       |       |-- context head + canvas checkpoints
|       |       |       |-- diagramHistory --------> diagram history record reference
|       |       |       `-- snapshots[id].diagramCheckpointId -> binding map
|       |       |           `-- no embedded diagram revision tables on disk
|       |       `-- ascii / diagram / mapping-canvas
|       |           `-- retained supported formats; materialized by read adapters
|       |   |
|       |   `-- projections[id]                    relationships between representations
|       |       |-- source representation / revision
|       |       |-- target representation / revision
|       |       `-- links                          source evidence -> target tree nodes
|       |
|       |-- CompactionCatalog                         ProjectCatalogStore compatibility adapter
|       |   |-- activeByPath[path] ----------------> compactions[id]
|       |   `-- compactions[id]: FileCompaction
|       |       |-- source path / source hash
|       |       |-- startLine / endLine
|       |       |-- originalLines
|       |       `-- compactedSource                retained source presentation
|       |
|       `-- Operations
|           |-- promoteRepresentation(...)
|           |   `-- Generated artifact -> saved identity + captured revision.
|           |
|           |-- saveMappingDiagram(...)
|           |   |-- expected saved revision still current -> validate and save
|           |   |-- saved head advanced -> catalogRules / DiagramRevisionEditor.merge(...)
|           |   |   |-- changed diagram bindings -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|           |   |   `-- unchanged bindings -> CANVAS_CONFLICT
|           |   |-- validate history matches scene + edges
|           |   |-- reject mutation of an existing diagram revision
|           |   |-- missing history -> import / continue compatible history
|           |   |-- DiagramPersistence.persist(catalog) -> diagram records first
|           |   `-- atomic canvases/catalog.json write -> canvas references
|           |
|           |-- saveProjectedTree(...)
|           |   `-- Derived tree -> saved representation + projection relationship.
|           |
|           `-- archiveRepresentation(...)
|               `-- Retire the saved identity while retaining its history.
|
|-- DiagramRevisionStore                          immutable diagram records
|   |-- diagrams/diagram/<hash>.json               content + sourceContext + jumps
|   |-- diagrams/revision/<hash>.json              revision envelope + diagram reference
|   |-- diagrams/history/<hash>.json               revisions + checkpoint binding maps
|   `-- atomic writes; SHA-256 identity and integrity checks
|
|-- Storage compatibility
|   |-- ProjectCatalogStore extends CanvasCatalogStore; projectCatalogs aliases canvases
|   |-- reads prefer canvases/catalog.json; fall back to representations/catalog.json
|   `-- DiagramPersistence.restore accepts old embedded data and new references
|       `-- API responses / exports remain expanded portable histories
|
|-- MappingWorkspaceStore                         saved editing session
|   |-- WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |   |-- workspace-records.json                 manifest / revision / receipts
|   |   `-- workspace-records/<hash>.json          record payloads
|   |-- loadRecords() / applyBatch()               incremental record transport
|   `-- load() / save()                            snapshot compatibility
|       `-- DiagramPersistence                    legacy record expansion
|
|-- Workspace autosave
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace / SourcePaneViewState changes
|   `-- WorkspacePersistence -> RecordStorage -> workspaceStorage.worker
|       `-- POST record batch -> WorkspaceRecordStore.apply()
|           `-- detail: Workspace persistence flow
|
|-- Explicit catalog publication
|   `-- Save / save_diagram -> document + history -> saveMappingDiagram(...)
|       `-- workspace autosave does not advance the saved catalog revision
|
|-- DiagramChangeSessionStore                      proposal persistence
|   `-- ChangeSessionRecords
|       |-- session manifest: summary + document / receipt references
|       |-- content-addressed document and receipt payloads
|       `-- DiagramPersistence -> immutable diagram/history references
|           `-- detail: ChangeSession / [P]
|
`-- SearchArtifact persistence                    PROPOSED derived output
    |
    |-- DiagramSearchArtifact
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> parsed diagram content
    |   |-- searchable text                       node labels with original line labels
    |   `-- row metadata -------------------------> node ID + original text location
    |
    |-- Mapped source-file membership
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> diagram source mappings
    |   |-- source identity + path                one entry per referenced file
    |   |-- search scope                          complete file contents
    |   `-- owners -------------------------------> referencing diagram nodes
    |
    `-- Persistence hooks
        |-- Diagram created / revised -> write its SearchArtifact.
        |-- Mappings saved -----------> update mapped source-file membership.
        `-- Diagram archived / removed -> remove obsolete search membership.
